Name: Bonghits' Weapon and Magic Expansion
Author: Deathshift
TagLine: A medium sized collection of weapon additions that come with some fun magic!
Description:
Most non-magical weapons are available at the Adventurer's Guild, as well as all basic potions. Weapons will drop in the caves in containers/chests.

Duality:
Mines Level 50+
Fires Fireball Projectile When Swung
Projectile Damage: 80

Flamberge:
Craftable!
The Flamberge costs 10 Iron Bars, 2 Gold Bars, 10 Wood and 1 Esperite
Mines Level 40+

Ragnarok:
﻿
Mines Level 70+
Big Knockback
Thunder Sound
Small Explosion on Swing
10% Chance to drop Diamonds on Kill
Heals 20% Health on Critical Strike
Special: Explosion AoE
[Special Attack Requires Combat Level 8]

Inferno's Embrace:
﻿
Mines Level 70+
Fires multiple fiery particles
One particle will bounce
Once particle will explode on impact
One particle will simply fire
Projectile Damage 55-100
